verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs claim it integrates through "native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports" (pigment-docs-7). Its official MCP server lets external assistants query role- and metric-scoped business data (pigment-docs-2, pigment-docs-4, pigment-probe-4), which gives some programmatic read access to model outputs. However, no evidence documents an export endpoint or warehouse sync for metrics, forecasts or scenario results, and no OpenAPI spec was found (pigment-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented export/read API for model outputs, warehouse connectors or scheduled exports, published API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
